answer_text:
## [Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist](https://www.wakehealth.edu) (wakehealth.edu)

**wakehealth.edu** is the official website of **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, a major academic medical center based in **Winston-Salem, North Carolina**. Here's an overview of what the site offers:

---

### 🏥 Patient Care
Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center offers expert medical care and advanced treatments in Winston-Salem, NC. The site helps patients:

- Find online doctor appointments and physicians in Winston-Salem, NC & surrounding areas.
- Access a range of immediate care options, including convenient medical care nearby or from home.
- Understand medical bills, discuss payment options, and get accurate estimates for out-of-pocket expenses.

---

### 🩺 Clinical Services
Some of the most frequently searched services include:
- Orthopaedic surgeons and specialists who treat every type of orthopaedic condition with advanced techniques and research-based approaches.
- Pediatric experts including more than 150 pediatricians and pediatric surgeons specializing in more than 30 areas, as well as board-certified primary care providers.
- Other highlighted services include a **Comprehensive Cancer Center**, **Heart and Vascular Center**, **Neurology and Neurosurgery**, and more.

---

### 📱 Patient Portal (MyAtriumHealth)
The portal for Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist patients is now **MyAtriumHealth**, which provides a convenient experience to access your health information. You can sign in from the website or download the free MyAtriumHealth App in your App Store.

---

### 🎓 Academic & Research Mission
The site also connects to **Wake Forest University School of Medicine** (school.wakehealth.edu):

- Wake Forest University School of Medicine directs the education of nearly 1,900 students and fellows, including physicians, basic scientists, and allied clinical professionals.
- The school has a nationally recognized research program, garnering over $400 million in extramural funding. The PA program is ranked #11 and the Nurse Anesthesia program is ranked #12 in the country.
- The School of Medicine is one of the most selective medical training programs in the nation and encompasses multiple programs, including MD, PA Studies, DNP, and biomedical graduate programs.

---

### 🔗 Recent News
Hugh Chatham Health has officially joined Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist.
